basic_info.description: Located in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, Potrero Hill, this full-floor  Marina-style flat combines classic architecture with modern updates and a bright, open feel. Partial  views of Downtown and the Bay provide a stunning backdrop, while a private brick patio extends the  living space outdoors. The main level offers two bedrooms with custom closets, and two full  bathrooms. A stylish & updated kitchen, fresh paint, and newly refinished hardwood floors give the home  a crisp, move-in ready appeal. A living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and a large family room that opens to the patio create an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. In-unit laundry adds to the convenience. Downstairs, just off the garage, a versatile multipurpose room with a full bath works perfectly as a guest suite, office or creative space. One car parking, EV Charger and ample storage are included. Enjoy a highly walkable setting just minutes from Whole Foods, Chez Maman, Goat Hill Pizza and Plow- just a few of the neighborhood's favorite cafes and shops. Don't miss this rare opportunity!
